name: WCAG 2.2 AA
note: The criteria the page checks can measure in a real browser, and the ones that need a person with a keyboard.

rules.name: An image has no alt text
A form field has no label
Text is hard to read against its background
The page scrolls sideways on a phone
A positive tabindex changes the keyboard order
rules.good: <button> in the order it should be reached

rules.name: A control has no accessible name
Text doesn't survive being enlarged
rules.question: At 200% text size, is everything still readable and usable, with nothing cut off or overlapping?

rules.name: A new control can't be used with a keyboard
rules.question: Can every new control be reached and used with the keyboard alone, in a sensible order?

rules.name: The keyboard focus is invisible
rules.question: Is the keyboard focus visible on every new control, in light and dark?

rules.name: A new target is too small to press
rules.question: Is every new button, link or icon at least 24 by 24 CSS pixels, or spaced so it is easy to hit?

rules.name: An error doesn't say what is wrong
rules.question: When input is rejected, does the message say which field and what to change, in text, not only in colour?
